page_evidence_map.claim: Transformer：不用循环、不用卷积，序列转导只靠注意力
动机：主流模型背着 RNN/CNN 的串行包袱，训练慢
page_evidence_map.quote: The dominant sequence transduction models are based on complex recurrent or convolutional neural networks in an encoder-decoder configuration.

page_evidence_map.claim: 方法主干：多头注意力让模型同时在多个表示子空间里对齐信息
page_evidence_map.quote: Multi-head attention allows the model to jointly attend to information from different representation subspaces at different positions.

page_evidence_map.claim: 方法主干：多头注意力让模型同时在多个表示子空间里对齐信息
page_evidence_map.quote: We propose a new simple network architecture, the Transformer, based solely on attention mechanisms, dispensing with recurrence and convolutions entirely.

page_evidence_map.claim: 换掉循环换来什么：更短的最大路径长度、更少的串行步
page_evidence_map.quote: Maximum path lengths, per-layer complexity and minimum number of sequential operations

page_evidence_map.claim: 结果：28.4 BLEU（EN-DE），比含 ensemble 的最好结果还高 2 BLEU 以上
page_evidence_map.quote: Our model achieves 28.4 BLEU on the WMT 2014 English-to-German translation task, improving over the existing best results, including ensembles by over 2 BLEU.

page_evidence_map.claim: 结果：28.4 BLEU（EN-DE），比含 ensemble 的最好结果还高 2 BLEU 以上
page_evidence_map.quote: The Transformer achieves better BLEU scores than previous state-of-the-art models on the English-to-German and English-to-French newstest2014 tests at a fraction of the training cost.

page_evidence_map.claim: 消融：多头不是玄学——单头掉 0.9 BLEU，头太多也掉
page_evidence_map.quote: single-head attention is 0.9 BLEU worse than the best setting, quality also drops off with too many heads.

page_evidence_map.claim: 下一步：借多头与位置编码；风险在'小数据是否仍占优'
page_evidence_map.quote: We show that the Transformer generalizes well to other tasks by applying it successfully to English constituency parsing both with large and limited training data.

page_evidence_map.claim: 下一步：借多头与位置编码；风险在'小数据是否仍占优'
page_evidence_map.quote: 论文仅在 WMT 级数据与成分句法任务上验证，未覆盖我们组的低资源场景

page_evidence_map.claim: 备份 A：为什么不用 RNN？三种层的复杂度对照
page_evidence_map.quote: Maximum path lengths, per-layer complexity and minimum number of sequential operations

page_evidence_map.claim: 备份 B：EN-FR 训练成本细节
page_evidence_map.quote: On the WMT 2014 English-to-French translation task, our model establishes a new single-model state-of-the-art BLEU score of 41.8 after training for 3.5 days on eight GPUs, a small fraction of the training costs of the best models from the literature.

qa_preparation.q: 这篇和我们的方向有什么关系？
qa_preparation.a: 我们的 seq2seq 管线里 RNN 编码器可以直接对照替换，第 4 页讲细节。
组里都熟，砍掉了，原文献 §2 可自行查阅。

qa_preparation.q: attention 不是早就有了吗，新在哪？
qa_preparation.a: 新在'只用'注意力：把 RNN/CNN 整个替换掉而不是叠加。
防止内积过大把 softmax 推进饱和区，梯度消失；论文 §3.2.1 有推导。
第 7 页消融给了答案。
论文用 restricted self-attention（r 邻域）作对照，我们后续可关注稀疏注意力方向。

qa_preparation.q: 和 GNMT/ConvS2S 的 FLOPs 对比具体多少？
qa_preparation.a: 表 2 原表逐项列出（p.8），口述易错，建议现场翻原文；数字见备份页 B2 的表格页。
论文未给机制解释，只报告现象；每头维度被摊薄可能是原因之一（我们的推测，inferred）。

qa_preparation.q: 低资源场景有没有旁证？
